name: Shadcn/UI Landing Page Template
summary: React landing page template with 16 ready sections — navbar, hero, stats, pricing, testimonials, FAQ and more — on shadcn/ui.
description: A landing page template for React built with shadcn/ui, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. It ships the sections a product page needs — navbar, mobile sidebar, hero, sponsors, about, stats, how it works, features, services, CTA, testimonials, team, pricing, newsletter, FAQ and footer — fully responsive, with dark mode and meta tags.
